en-US.author: motemen, Songmu
en-US.longDescription: 'ghq' provides a way to organize remote repository clones, like go get does. When you clone a remote repository by ghq get, ghq makes a directory under a specific root directory (by default ~/ghq) using the remote repository URL’s host and path.
en-US.name: ghq
